question_en: List the resolutions and the approved CRs that modify spec 38.133 (decision-to-change trace).

semantic_evidence.original_quote: the resolutions and the approved CRs
semantic_evidence.finding: The conjunction requests both identities in each recorded trace. The original projection supplies exactly those two fields. Both are required nonnull strings, not titles, a scalar, or a Resolution-only answer.
semantic_evidence.original_source_derivation: ROOT independently read exact English, original two-column projection and own P3 domain. Neither a third unrequested column nor external evidence is a scored answer field.
semantic_evidence.strongest_counterargument_and_resolution: Parent Korean CQ4-1 asks for a different parameterized projection; it cannot replace the exact evaluated English two-role request.

semantic_evidence.finding: The original recorded Resolution-reference/CR-target composition defines the lookup population. Fresh immutable SQL reopened all 1766 paths, 216 Resolution nodes and 1733 CR nodes. The retained top CON identity and all 28 potential paths are literal source records; no physical approval body is inferred from its node label.
semantic_evidence.original_source_derivation: P2 explicitly defines Resolution text markers and literal Tdoc REFERENCES; P3 reuses REFERENCES for CQ4 and P1 target metadata for MODIFIES. ROOT reopened the report ZIP/member, full context XML/styles and both original final registers.
semantic_evidence.strongest_counterargument_and_resolution: The top CON marker is a RAN1 #92 quotation inside R4-2007663's Abstract and its extracted record extends through later Tdoc records. This is admissible here as the existing documentary trace identity, not evidence that this quoted conclusion itself approved every referenced CR. The exact English conjunction requests recorded resolution/approved-CR pairs and contains no approval-agent predicate.

semantic_evidence.finding: Affirmative frozen CR document status is required in addition to the unchanged reference and target. P1 defines agreed, approved and endorsed as positive states; P2 expressly assigns document outcomes to P1 status separately from technical Resolution blocks. This conjunction preserves that composition. At the complete cutoff, original registers confirm 18 positive-state CRs: 14 current own-document outcomes and four explicitly earlier-endorsed CRs.
semantic_evidence.original_source_derivation: The four earlier endorsements are directly described at original paragraph indices 4496, 4504, 4552 and 4564 and their final register values match frozen CR status. The five-term positive-state diagnostic and three-term predicate yield the same full 635 pairs; the other two P1 values introduce no excluded eligible CR here.
semantic_evidence.strongest_counterargument_and_resolution: Parent Korean describes CRs approved by a Resolution. Imposing that stronger agent/event condition on this instance would change its exact English conjunction, which says resolutions AND approved CRs and does not say approved BY those resolutions or at this meeting. Therefore recorded reference plus affirmative document status is accepted for this question. This conclusion must not be reused for D48's explicit approved BY agreements question, or described publicly as proof of same-Resolution causal approval or all-time approval history.

semantic_evidence.original_quote: the resolutions and the approved CRs
semantic_evidence.finding: A result record is a Resolution/CR pair, preserving the original joined-path projection without new DISTINCT. All 635 filtered paths have unique visible pairs. Multiple CRs linked from one Resolution remain separate requested answers.
semantic_evidence.original_source_derivation: Independent ROOT SQL matched complete candidate output, literal full CR records and original frontier paths. Full-pair uniqueness was checked rather than assumed from a captured top ten.
semantic_evidence.strongest_counterargument_and_resolution: Deduplicating only Resolution IDs would erase the second requested role and yield a different task; no such relaxation is used.

semantic_evidence.finding: Preserve the authored finite ten-pair extent. Own P3 default list limit is ten and exact instance has LIMIT 10. Complete filtered population is 635; the highest original source ordering key has 18 eligible pairs, so exactly ten distinct pairs are required.
semantic_evidence.original_source_derivation: Fresh full output, not merely one selected slice, establishes the rank frontier. The original English contains no all/each/unlimited extent overriding its original finite query convention.
semantic_evidence.strongest_counterargument_and_resolution: Returning all 18 tied rows or all 635 satisfies neither the finite list nor its contract. The unchanged scorer rejects both incorrect extent and missing or duplicate rows.

semantic_evidence.finding: The only original rank key is Resolution ID descending. Every admissible answer chooses any ten distinct pairs from the same highest-ID group of 18, with free serialization within that tie. No invented CR secondary ordering or one arbitrary native slice defines gold.
semantic_evidence.original_source_derivation: The exact query ordering overrides generic parent defaults. Existing unmodified top_k_boundary_ties scoring represents the 43,758 valid sets; two genuinely different valid subsets, reversal, lower-ID substitution and excluded statuses were tested in 4 positive/25 adverse controls.
semantic_evidence.strongest_counterargument_and_resolution: Native and SQLite can choose different ten-pair subsets. Their full 635-row populations must agree; both finite outputs must independently satisfy the same tie-aware contract rather than equal each other by arbitrary engine order.
